annotations.title: Add a line to a list

description: Adds one line to another tab of the track's sheet, a list it keeps beside its rows (plans, money moved between budgets, chores, people on a rota), when the person tells you one. Not for the data tab: add_rows does that. Call it with trackId and tab alone to get the list's columns (fields: key, label, type, enumValues), which come from the tab's own headers; then with values, an object of column keys or header names to values (dates as YYYY-MM-DD). The line goes under the last one, columns a formula fills are left alone, and Added by and Added at columns are filled when the tab has them. get_glance with forEditing lists the sheet's tabs.

tab.description: The tab's name, as the sheet shows it.

values.description: The line: each column's key or header to its value. Leave out to get the list's columns.
